sentences.text: Sequiwaimanu is an extinct genus of early penguin found in the Waipara Greensand of New Zealand.
The type species Sequiwaimanu rosieae was named and described by Gerald Mayr in 2018.
The holotype specimen — the specific fossil the species is based on — was discovered within the Claremont Estate, which was owned by Richard Goord at the time.
Sequiwaimanu possessed leg bones that were similar to those of an unnamed giant penguin.
Sequiwaimanu belongs to the parent group Sphenisciformes.
Sequiwaimanu lived between 61.66 and 56 million years ago during the Selandian to Thanetian stages.
